title: Minecraft BEST EASY IRON FARM 1.21 - NEW - 28 ~ 169 Stacks Per Hour!
description:
Hello Guys TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Super Easy Compact Iron Farm In Minecraft 1.21

📚This iron farm will produce +1800 by each layer you can increase this rate by adding more layers to the farm
📚This is a new design for the iron farm its compact, the range, size, heights, and other things are changed in this design to make the farm simple
📚In this design, we used the easiest type of room for villagers that make the farm so simple
📚You can build this farm in 20 - 60 mins and it's so simple ( recommended for beginners )
📚also, you can add more layers to the farm, for this just go up by 15 - 16 blocks from the villagers ( rooftop - trapdoor ) and repeat the same you did in the bottom layer.
📚You can also build this farm anywhere you want in the air or ocean, except for frozen biomes.
